visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons/pills

components.Card: Flat background, subtle border, no heavy drop shadows default, lift on hover
components.Kanban: Custom drag-and-drop columns using @hello-pangea/dnd. Columns have a muted background, cards are crisp white.
components.Input: Shadcn input with rounded-lg, focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary
components.Table: Clean lines, stripped rows with surface_alt, bold table headers

layouts.dashboard: F-Pattern scanning layout. Left sidebar on desktop, bottom tab bar or collapsible drawer on mobile.
layouts.kanban: Horizontal scrollable flex container for columns on mobile, CSS grid on desktop.
layouts.employee_entry: Minimalist centered layout, large autocomplete input, focused entirely on speed.

motion.kanban_drag: Scale up slightly (scale: 1.02) and add shadow while dragging

responsive.layout: Stack single column for forms/tables. Kanban converts to vertical stack or horizontal swipeable carousel on mobile. Hide sidebar, use hamburger menu.
responsive.typography: Scale down h1 to text-4xl on mobile. Ensure input text is 16px to prevent iOS zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: w-full max-w-full overflow-x-hidden for main container
responsive.tap_targets: min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] for all interactive elements

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text over background meets 4.5:1. Button text must contrast with primary color.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, inputs, and drag items (e.g., 'medicine-input', 'submit-btn', 'kanban-item-123')

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js/.jsx file extensions for React components. Do not use .tsx or TypeScript.
Use Cormorant Garamond for headings and Manrope for body text. Install via Google Fonts in index.css.
Implement the Kanban board for the Admin view using @hello-pangea/dnd. Ensure draggable items have a subtle shadow and scale up on drag.
Employee view must be extremely minimal: A large centered input with autocomplete, quantity, and a submit button.
Ensure the entire app uses an 'Apothecary / Warm Earthy' aesthetic. No pure whites (#FFFFFF is okay for cards, but background should be off-white #F9F8F6).
Use pill-shaped buttons with hover lift animations.
Design mobile-first. For mobile, the Kanban board should allow horizontal scrolling of columns.
Do NOT use pure black or generic greys. Tint greys with sage or warm sand.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
Use Shadcn components for inputs, dialogs, dropdowns, but heavily customize them to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Add rounded-xl or rounded-full, and use the custom earthy color palette.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
Do not center align the app container in App.css.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
